title: 1985 Topps #719 Gary Carter Montreal Expos Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 1985 Topps sports trading card features Gary Carter of the Montreal Expos, card number 719. It is a part of the base set and was manufactured by Topps. The card is from the Major League Baseball (MLB) and is perfect for collectors who love baseball. The card is in great shape and is a must-have for any fan of Gary Carter or the Montreal Expos.
